imageNote: This lesson is a worked diagnostic scenario ('the daily load didn't run') that chains together three separate diagnostic SQL functions across Snowpipe, Streams, and Tasks — there is no single Snowsight screen that shows this whole chain at once, and Snowflake's own docs cover each piece (pipe status, stream state, task history) as separate SQL reference pages with no combined-scenario screenshot. Covered honestly with an original steps/checklist card walking the real chain (pipe -> stream -> task -> downstream table) plus code cards with the real, correct diagnostic SQL for each link, rather than fabricating a single dashboard screenshot that doesn't exist in the product.
